title: Basic UI Library
features:
Basic Interface Suite

​Basic is a sleek, lightweight, and high-performance UI library designed for developers who prioritize a clean aesthetic and executor compatibility. Despite the name, it features a robust theme system and full Lucide icon support.

​Key Features

​Universal Compatibility: Uses gethui and custom parenting to ensure the UI works across all major executors without being detected by standard GUI scanners.

​Theme System: Has over 10+ Themes
Nebula
Obsidian
Aurora
Eclipse
Carbon
Ember
Glacier
Volt
Nova
Aether

​Lucide Icons: Integrated icon support pulled directly from a centralized asset table for a professional look.

​Optimized Elements: Features interactive sliders with smooth dragging mechanics, animated buttons, and persistent labels.

​Static Presence: ResetOnSpawn is disabled to ensure your interface stays on screen after character resets.
​Technical Details

​Library Name: Basic
​File Name: uilibrary.lua
​Design Philosophy: Minimalist and Compact

local Window = Library:CreateWindow("Basic Interface Suite", "aperture")

Window:Label("SpectravaxISBACK")

Window:CopyLabel("Copy this thingy", "You copied it")

Window:Button("Click Me!",function()

Window:Slider("Slider (Work In Progress!)", 1, 100, 50, function(v)
    print("Value: " .. v)
end)

local options = {}
for i = 1, 30 do
    table.insert(options, "Option " .. i)
end

Window:Dropdown("Choose an Option", options, function(selected)
    print("Selected: " .. selected)
end)
